conceptual_change: Introduce a volatility regime filter by requiring the current 14-period ATR to exceed 1.5 times its 20-period simple moving average prior to evaluating entry signals.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous rejection was based on missing implementation. This hypothesis formalizes the requirement for a high-volatility environment filter to potentially reduce false breakouts in low-liquidity, low-volatility periods identified in the baseline performance data.
